name: American First Finance (AFF)
notes: Researched from AFF's public Payments & Billing, Payment Solutions FAQs, Contact Us and Help Center pages (FAQ answers read from the page data; the pages render answers collapsed); never signed in. AFF services lease-to-own agreements, retail installment sale agreements and FinWise Bank installment loans; card statements show the charge as Amerfirstfinpayment.com. My Account (Customer Login) shows account details, transaction history, payment due date and amount owed (Account card), lets customers make and schedule additional payments, add a payment method and see discount (EPD/EBO) options; the sign-in identifier is not published, so auth keeps the family default; AFF says it uses multi-factor authentication (type not stated). Quick Pay exists in the site header, but its lookup fields are not public, so guest pay keeps the family default. Automatic payments: Set Up Auto Pay link in the Customer Portal or by phone (877) 544-0994; opting out is done by contacting customer service (modelled autopay_cancel unsupported). Payment schedules weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly per agreement; frequency changes by phone if current (monthly requires documentation) - not expressible. Late fees and NSF fees exist; amounts are in the agreement, not published. Early Payoff Discount (loans/RISA) and Early Buyout / Early Purchase options (leases) need payments larger than the scheduled ones by the expiry date; scheduled automatic payments do not exercise the EBO; overpayments are refunded to the same method. Leases can be cancelled any time without penalty by contacting AFF to return the merchandise. Hardship and missed-EPD payment plans are set up by phone. Customer service (877) 544-0994 (Payments & Billing) and 855-721-1188 (Contact Us), Mon-Fri 7am-8pm CT, Sat 8am-7pm CT; mail P.O. Box 565848, Dallas, TX 75356. REVIEW 2026-10-10: the public pages do not list which payment methods the portal accepts; billing.methods bank+card is the family default, not a documented claim.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: Set up automatic, recurring payments by logging in and selecting Set Up Auto Pay, or by calling (877) 544-0994. New customers can choose automatic payments in the Payment Authorization section when signing their agreement.
You can opt out of automatic payments at any time by contacting customer service.
Scheduled automatic payments do not pay off an Early Buyout Option or Early Payoff Discount; for that you need payments larger than your scheduled ones.

help.title: Payments and billing
paragraphs: A charge from Amerfirstfinpayment.com on your statement is American First Finance.

Payment schedules depend on your agreement: weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly. If your account is current you can ask to change the frequency to match your pay period by calling (877) 544-0994; a change to monthly also needs documents such as pay stubs or bank statements.
Late fees can apply. If you know you'll be late, call to schedule an alternate payment date. If you fall behind or face a hardship, call to discuss a payment plan.
Find your due date and amount owed on the Account card in My Account, where you can also schedule extra payments or add a payment method.

help.title: Early payoff and early buyout
paragraphs: Loans and retail installment contracts: pay the discounted amount during the Early Payoff Discount (EPD) period by making payments larger than your scheduled ones before the EPD expires. If you overpay, the extra is refunded to the same payment method.

Leases: the Early Buyout Option (EBO) gives the largest savings; after it ends you can still use the Early Purchase Option before the end of the agreement, or own the items by making all scheduled payments.
Make additional payments in the customer portal or by calling customer service. Your agreement shows the exact EPD or EBO period.

help.title: Return leased merchandise
paragraphs: A lease is not a loan. You can cancel it at any time without penalty by returning the merchandise; contact American First Finance to arrange the return.
If you become delinquent AFF may terminate the lease; bringing the lease current reinstates it.

help.title: Contact American First Finance
paragraphs: Payments and billing: (877) 544-0994. General customer service: 855-721-1188. Hours: Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. CT, Saturday 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. CT, closed Sunday. Online chat has the same hours.
Email info@americanfirstfinance.com. Mail about payments, approvals or credit disputes: P.O. Box 565848, Dallas, TX 75356.
AFF never asks for your password, full SSN, full card number or a one-time passcode by email, text or outbound call.
